### 1. User expression and simulator mode
Beatrice Calder, program owner, Delmont Cold Storage; wants to "file the service level credit claim for September 2026 today", will file it herself ("you only need the desk to tell you the figure and the references"). Gives phone 3125550142, EIN last4 1846, ZIP 60609. Conditional lines: "If the agent tells you that something on the September invoice has to be put right before the credit can be worked out, you tell them to go ahead"; volunteers on request that the company "started paying its workers' transfer fees in the second half of the month". Simulator is passive / if-else; it executes the owner=user claim tool with the values the agent gives.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
Act now. Grounds: agreement 66379c3a… status `live`, tier `Paystride Program Enterprise`; September census `availability_percent: 99.31` < Enterprise commitment 99.9 (service_level_schedule: "Monthly platform availability commitment … Enterprise 99.9"); claim window "30 calendar days after the end of the affected month" → last day 2026-10-30, today 2026-10-13 in time (payments_and_credit_memos "Claim window"). ### 4. Formulas, factors and values
**(a) Per-worker fee and billing-error credit** (per_worker_fee_computation + its factor docs):
- Baseline: 3.50 (Enterprise employer-paid per-worker fee) × 1242 = 4347.00 → billing-error credit 0 (fall-back answer: no credit, line already "correct").
- Method — graduated_per_worker_rates: 1242 > 1000 → 1000×3.50 + 242×(0.85×3.50) = 3500.00 + 719.95 = 4219.95.
- Multiplier — part_month_per_worker_billing: latest effective change to employer-paid has effective_date 2026-09-19, later than 2026-09-01 and 18 days after it (<30) → × (30−18)/30 = 0.4 → 1687.98.
- Percentages taken off, summed once: launch pricing (go-live 2026-05-04 → 3 whole months to 2026-09-01, <6 → 10%); Payroll Card bundle per-worker (live, launch 2026-06-12 ≤ 2026-09-01, Standard = "any other package" → 5%); term commitment (signed 2026-03-04 → renewal 2029-03-04 = 36 whole months → 5%); workforce adoption (1242/2104 = 0.590 → ≥0.3 <0.6 → 2%). Total 22% → 1687.98 × 0.78 = 1316.6244 → per-worker fee 1316.62 (rounded once at the end).
- Billing-error credit = 4347.00 − 1316.62 = 3030.38 (≤ unpaid 4347.00; line carries no billing-error credit yet).
- Tier evidence: census Sep row (eligible 2104, enrolled 1242); agreement (go_live_date, signed_date, renewal_date, variant); change request 7070f6d9; paycard program record (cross-product: paycard).

**(b) SLA credit for Sep 2026** (latest_month_service_level_credit_computation + factors):
- Baseline percentage: 99.31 is ≥ 99.0 and below 99.9 → 10%. Baseline base: platform line 1062.50 less billing-error credit on it (none) = 1062.50. Fall-back answer: 10% × 1062.50 = 106.25.
- Fee lines covered (fee_lines_covered_by_service_level_credit): invoice carries a per-worker fee line → add 4347.00 − 3030.38 = 1316.62 → base 2379.12.
- Multipliers: availability_shortfall_depth 99.9−99.31 = 0.59 ≥ 0.5 → 1.3; consecutive_month_breaches: latest-billing-month earlier SLA credit is for 2026-08 (immediately before) → 1.15; post_go_live_stabilization: 2026-05-04 → 2026-09-01 = 3 whole months (<6) → 0.75; repeated_service_level_breaches: SLA credits booked 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-10, both < 6 whole months before 2026-10-13 → 2 → 1.2.
- Percentage = 10 × 1.3 × 1.15 × 0.75 × 1.2 = 13.455%; credit = 2379.12 × 0.13455 = 320.1106 → **320.11**.

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone
- Root: the employer's SLA credit claim for 2026-09 (user write).
- Hop 1 (state-derived): fee_lines_covered_by_service_level_credit — "A service level credit for a month is not fixed until the per-worker fee line billed for that month carries the billing-error credit owed on it for any amount billed above the per-worker fee." Records: Sep per-worker line e7044a60 billed 4347.00, no credit memo pointing to it; computing the per-worker fee per per_worker_fee_computation and its factor docs gives 1316.62 < 4347.00 → state does not hold. Searching "billing-error credit … per-worker fee line" finds per_worker_fee_billing_error_credits ("The billing-error credit owed on that line is booked by the desk as a credit memo pointing to it"), whose own tool books it. Not pre-solved: the SLA documents name no tool of the per-worker policy.
- Order: billing-error credit (agent) → SLA claim (user). No further hop: per-worker docs state no waited-on state.
- Counter-proof "do only the claim": filing with the base read before the credit uses per-worker line 4347.00 (base 5409.50 → 727.85 at 13.455%) — excluded by the sentence above (credit not fixed while the line lacks the owed credit) and by "less any billing-error credit booked against it".
- Closest alternatives excluded: old platform ladder (payments_and_credit_memos clause "no longer in force"; service_level_credit_claims "for the latest census month its amount is settled by these provisions"); part-month by go-live instead of change (ruling item 2 only "where no such effective date falls in that span"); Premier/Elite 10% (record says Standard).
